title: I created a 24/7 stream where GPT, Claude, and Gemini play a board game against each other
author: DntWry0

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body:
Self promotion and no links? 

More than this it would be cool to make them create a JS trainer for bots and see who builds the stronger bot. Then try the same with a python Jax engine. I might be wrong, but I will guess AI on their own are not very good players.

replies.author: DntWry0
replies.body: Reddit filters were having a field day with my post so I tried just posting without a link. That would also be a great concept to implement as well. Yes, you make a valid point they may not be good players but we can see which one is the best option.

comments.author: voyager2005
comments.body: this looks like Catan almost lol

replies.author: DntWry0
replies.body: Yea, its built on Catanatron, an open-source engine for that style of game. Since I'm not affiliated with any board game company, I keep all the naming and art original.
